title: Ding
blurb: Bell-clear, instantly understood, and infinitely applicable — the atom from which every other notification sound is built. An idea arriving, a lift reaching your floor, an order coming up, a point landing squarely in an argument: all of them are served by exactly one clean ding. There is no cleverness here and no branding, which is the entire appeal; the sound does not want anything from you. When a moment needs marking and nothing elaborate will do, this is the tool. The most honest file in the catalogue — it dings, and that is the complete feature set.
origin: One clean bell ding — the universal alert.
